label: Unrelated
research: The archival abstract names Thomas Rosenberg only as a witness to Heinrich Trösch von Waldsee’s appeal, alongside a Rottweil citizen. A project name search found no other structured occurrence of Thomas; neither the surname nor the Nuremberg court establishes membership in the Franken, Sulzbach or any other listed family. The archive catalogue provides no further family identifier: https://www.gda.bayern.de/gvl/document/7bb8da48-406b-4cbd-89c4-f7cda9d451ac. Attribution unresolved. A second search under Thomas von Rosenberg finds the Boxberg surety of 1452 (1452-10-02.json). Two Ansbach-area records already call him deceased in May and July 1459 (1459-05-22.json and 1459-07-18.json), ruling him out as the November witness. The witness remains unidentified. The catalogue’s issue-place and dating fields add that the appeal was made in Rottweil, at the home of the underscribe Michel Rosenberg, whom it also indexes by name. This places Thomas with another surname bearer in a Rottweil court setting. The catalogue gives no relationship between the two men. https://www.gda.bayern.de/gvl/document/7bb8da48-406b-4cbd-89c4-f7cda9d451ac

Instrument des Notars Johannes von Entringen: Heinrich Trösch von Waldsee erhebt Berufung an Markgraf Albrecht von Brandenburg gegen ein Urteil des Landgerichts Nürnberg in seiner Streitsache mit Hans Tracht von Nürnberg. -  Zeugen: der gen. Unterschreiber, Thomas Rosenberg, Claus Goldschmid, Bürger zu Rottweil.

entries.english:
Instrument of Notary Johannes von Entringen: Heinrich Trösch von Waldsee appeals to Margrave Albrecht of Brandenburg against a judgment of the Regional Court of Nuremberg in his dispute with Hans Tracht of Nuremberg. - Witnesses: the aforementioned underscribe, Thomas Rosenberg, Claus Goldschmid, citizen of Rottweil.

Notes: Reverse side of one copy: Receipt notation, presented by Conrad von Eib through ### Wolfram Wörner. (?) 07. XII.
